mood: Sterile clinical horror: a diagnostic monitor of a specimen slide. Cold enamel instruments on lab tile, a corridor of tissue with a heartbeat traced down it, and the soft, wrong colours of the things that crawl along it.

fonts.display: Archivo (heavy for the VEGA wordmark; condensed capitals, width 66-75, for labels and specimen tags)
fonts.mono: IBM Plex Mono (every number, coordinate, log line and tag)

shape.radius: near-square (2px) with a clipped top-right corner on buttons, like a slide label; enamel instruments get a soft 14% radius
shape.borderStyle: 1px surgical-green hairlines (#1D3A31, #2F5D4F on emphasis); the mint outline marks what is selected
shape.texture: lab tile grid with corner ticks, static scanlines every 3-4px, registration crosshairs in the corners, a 100 µm scale bar

motifs: specimen jar with the thing inside looking out
ECG trace with a QRS spike (wordmark underline, the corridor's centre line, the menu floor)
cold white enamel instruments with one mint status light
cell-like specimens: membranes, nuclei, cilia, keratin plates, shield bubbles
biohazard trefoil on the containment door
paper specimen tags in mono with a red stripe
buttonStyle: Primary is a flat surgical-mint fill with near-black ink in condensed Archivo capitals and a clipped top-right corner; secondary is a green-black panel with a hairline that turns mint on hover; danger is an arterial-red outline. No glow.
backdrop: Near-black green glass with a lab-tile grid, corner registration marks, static scanlines and a vignette; the menu adds a large specimen jar on the right and a flat ECG trace across the floor; the board is the same monitor with the tissue corridor laid in.
motion: Specimen membranes ripple slowly and the monitor's scan line drifts down every nine seconds; both stop under Globe motion: Still. Hits, deaths and splashes are responses that end within 360 ms; a leak darkens the screen edge in red over 600 ms, at most once a second. Nothing flashes or pulses.
